# netactuate_oidc_client_bare_metal_allow_list (Resource)

Manages an OIDC Client Bare Metal Allow List.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_oidc_client_bare_metal_allow_list" "example" {
  mbpkgid        = 12345
  oidc_client_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Bare metal package ID to allow.
- `oidc_client_id` (Number) OIDC client ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_oidc_client_bare_metal_allow_list.example 12345
```
